description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayDiscoveryModel component of the OpenClawDiscovery module. It covers parsing gateway TXT records, matching gateways, building SSH targets, and deduplication logic, using the XCTest framework with custom test annotations.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModelTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for GatewayDiscoveryModel functionalities, using the @Test annotation to denote individual test cases.

methods.name: `local gateway matches lan host`
methods.description: Tests if GatewayDiscoveryModel correctly identifies a local gateway based on LAN host matching.

methods.name: `local gateway matches tailnet dns`
methods.description: Tests matching local gateway based on tailnet DNS name.

methods.name: `local gateway matches display name`
methods.description: Tests matching local gateway using display name.

methods.name: `remote gateway does not match`
methods.description: Verifies that a gateway with mismatched fields does not falsely match the local gateway criteria.

methods.name: `local gateway matches service name`
methods.description: Checks if matching based on service name works correctly.

methods.name: `service name does not false positive on substring host token`
methods.description: Ensures that service name matching does not produce false positives due to substring overlaps with host tokens.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT fields`
methods.description: Validates correct parsing of TXT record fields into gateway properties.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT defaults`
methods.description: Checks proper handling of missing or malformed TXT fields with default values.

methods.name: `builds SSH target`
methods.description: Tests creation of SSH target string with and without custom port.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery continues when DNS-SD already found a remote gateway`
methods.description: Verifies that discovery continues if remote gateways are already found.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery stops after serve result is found`
methods.description: Ensures discovery process halts appropriately after a serve gateway is discovered.

methods.name: `dedupe key prefers resolved endpoint across sources`
methods.description: Tests that deduplication favors endpoints with fully resolved addresses.

methods.name: `dedupe key falls back to stable ID without endpoint`
methods.description: Checks that the deduplication uses the stable ID when endpoints are unresolved.
